Bachelor of Arts in Ministry Leadership

America Evangelical University offers a Bachelor’s degree in Ministry Leadership based on 120 semester units. The program may be completed in four academic years of full-time study. 4 years    |    120 units
About Program
Program Overview

America Evangelical University offers a Bachelor’s degree in Ministry Leadership based on 120 semester units. The program may be completed in four academic years of full-time study. The BA in Ministry Leadership (BAML) is designed to equip students for pastoral ministry and leadership within the local church, as well as in Christian or non-Christian non-profit and mission organizations. The BAML program will provide students with an extensive knowledge of the Bible and a biblically-based theology. The apprenticeship (Practicum / Internship), an integral component of the program, may be completed in a church or a marketplace setting, as well as at a non-profit or a mission organization.

Highlight Program
Highlights of the Program

Theologically and Biblically Grounded

The courses and practical training offered by the BAML program lay a solid biblical and theological foundation for vital ministry as well as for advanced studies in global and cross-cultural communication

Contextualization

BAML students are provided the opportunity to adapt their studies to a particular context, by completing a concentration in a church ministry setting or with a non-profit institution as well as with an organization that requires specialized expertise.

Practical and Experiential

The BAML program offers a new and relevant level of specialized theological and experiential education. Students will develop additional skills as well as practical application in leadership and ministry. The integrated experience blends leadership, management, and organizational training with practical theology and a strong biblical foundation.

Clarifying Your Calling

The new level of the formational mentoring, ongoing collaboration, mutual support and small group reflection that is offered by the BAML program allows students to refine and holistically prepare for their distinct vocational calling.

Offering Flexible Classroom/Online Setting

AEU’s BAML accommodates leaders and working adults whose responsibilities and schedules do not permit enrollment in a traditional college degree program. The cohort model allows students to engage with professors and build community, resulting in a valuable and long-lasting support network

Potential Fields
Potential Fields of Employment

AEU's BAML program prepares graduates for employment in

  • Ministry leadership (Youth pastor
  • Chaplaincy
  • Christian non-profit Organizations
  • Christian education
  • And many other fields
Requirements
Admission Requirements

The criteria for entrance to the Bachelor of Arts in Ministry Leadership are:

1. Completion of Application Form for Admission.
2. Three letters of recommendation from faculty, employers, or church leaders.
3. Possession of or candidacy for a high school diploma or GED.
[Completion of high school or the GED is required before formally enrolling in the university.]
4. A statement of the applicant’s Christian faith.
5. One recent photograph.
6. An official transcript from high school, as well as from any post-high school education.
7. A personal interview with a representative of the university.
8. A sense of calling from God for Christian ministry.
9. Regeneration experience and baptism with water.
10. Active and fruitful church participation.
11. Payment of $100.00 application fee.
